theory.title: Conectores discursivos de contraste, concesión y resultado
theory.explanation: Usa although y even though antes de una oración completa; despite e in spite of antes de un sustantivo o de un verbo en -ing. However introduce una idea contrastiva, mientras que therefore y as a result expresan consecuencia.
theory.tip: Although/even though + oración; despite/in spite of + sustantivo o -ing. Therefore/as a result introducen una consecuencia.

content.passage: The group planned an outdoor event. Although the forecast was poor, they decided to continue. However, they prepared an indoor room in case it rained. Despite the extra work, everyone stayed positive. One volunteer suggested a shorter programme; as a result, the schedule became easier to manage. The rain arrived early. Nevertheless, the event moved inside and continued successfully. The organisers thanked everyone for helping, and they agreed to use the same plan next time.

content.audioTranscript: A: Our local group is organising an event for new neighbours. B: What activities are planned? A: We asked people what they needed and offered help. B: Some people had different ideas, but everyone listened carefully. A: We will not share private details without permission. B: And if the weather is bad? A: We will use the hall. Since the first meeting, we have been sharing updates.
